def clean(df):
    # Convert text numbers to proper numeric types
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    # Standardize species and island labels to the allowed values (case‑fold and map)
    species_map = {"adelie": "Adelie", "gentoo": "Gentoo"}
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip().str.title().replace(species_map)
    island_map = {"bisco": "Biscoe", "dram": "Dream"}
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip().replace(island_map)
    # Remove duplicate rows (keep first occurrence)
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Sum body_mass_g for each species
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum().to_dict()
    return result
